items.followUp: Differentiate between an element and a compound.

rubric.why: A homogeneous mixture has the same composition throughout.
rubric.description: States that a homogeneous mixture has a uniform composition throughout.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark if both key terms are present.

rubric.why: A heterogeneous mixture does not have a uniform composition; its parts may differ.
rubric.description: States that a heterogeneous mixture has nonuniform composition or different parts.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for either accepted description.

modelAnswer: A homogeneous mixture has a uniform composition throughout.
A heterogeneous mixture has a nonuniform composition, and its different parts may be distinguishable.

items.followUp: Write the subshell electronic configuration of an element with atomic number 17.

rubric.why: These subshells account for the first ten electrons.
rubric.description: Gives the correct occupancies of 1s, 2s and 2p.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark when all three subshell occupancies are correct.

rubric.why: The remaining five electrons occupy 3s and 3p.
rubric.description: Gives the correct occupancies of 3s and 3p.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark when both subshell occupancies are correct.

modelAnswer: Atomic number = 15, so the atom has 15 electrons.
